comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
I would like to create an OS X version soon. It should be possible to get Quest working using Mono, though a new UI would need to be created.

After the release of Quest 5, I plan to make a version of the Quest Player for OS X. The Editor would come later. If you are a Mac developer or know any, I'd certainly be grateful for any help!
